item.desc:stick: Planks split along the grain give sticks. Hafts, arrow shafts, staves and torches are made from them.
item.desc:coal: Old timber turns to coal in the rock, and a log chars to it in a furnace. A torch is a lump of it on a stick.
item.desc:flint: Gravel gives it up now and then. Knapped, it takes an edge, and it heads the plainest arrow.
item.desc:fiber: Tall grass, fern and reeds pull apart into fibre. Cord, thatch, bedrolls and Crystal Fiber are made of it.
item.desc:feather: Grouse drop it, and so do Jatu, bodied in the feather of birds they took. Arrows and kites are fletched with it.
item.desc:hide: Sheep and boar give it, and so do feeders bodied in the hide of what they ran down. Every Holder's Bed needs it.
item.desc:bone: Bone is what is left in the pot when a kill is boiled down. Tama carry it too. A driven crystal does not soften it.
item.desc:iron_bar: A furnace fire runs iron out of its rock, the last metal a crew wins without killing anything large.
item.desc:gold_bar: Gold runs out of its rock in a wood fire and stays soft under the hammer. It holds no edge. Feeders get nothing from it.
item.desc:lumenite: No fire touches this clear gem of the deep rock. It gives a cold light, and it is split along its joints on an anvil.
item.desc:mana_crystal: Old lees sets hard where nothing eats it. Driven through a cut line, a piece loosens whatever it is pointed at.
item.desc:cinder_bar: Bars of it come out of a Maruhar Furnace or a stronger one. Every metal from Jalit up costs a great kill.
item.desc:umbrite_bar: Whether Antar is iron nobody can say, since nobody has seen it before it set. A Maruhar Furnace runs it.
item.desc:noctrium_bar: Antar and Tala are one metal, and Tala lay lower and set harder. A Guhamāt Furnace or a stronger one runs it.
item.desc:aether_bar: A Guhamāt Furnace runs this island metal as it runs Tala. It is harder than any metal of the hollow.
item.desc:prism_bar: Patik runs only under remains as strong as Ratan's or stronger. The crystal shows through the bar.
item.desc:eclipse_bar: The hardest metal we work. Lees has set all through it.
item.desc:weave: Fibre is laid round crystal so that the cloth carries a cut line. Kites and the cloth worn for driving are made of it.
item.desc:effigy: Raw Tama flesh is bound to a carved bone. Two of them go into a totem, and a small feeder forms on the flesh.
item.desc:gel: A Kinva forms in this jelly, which rots out of fallen growth. It goes into the Vanahar Likeness and the Anklet.
item.desc:thorn: Kantak are bodied in bramble, and this is a piece of one. Set in a guard or a band, it cuts whatever strikes it.
item.desc:shade_essence: This is the dark matter of a Tama, raw. Chandasāvak carry it from the Tama they ate. Totems and bells take it.
item.desc:ember_dust: An Angār forms round a coal, and this is the dust of it. It burns longer than coal and goes into the Maruhar Lure.
item.desc:chitin: Each plate of a Silahādak is scale of the stone it ate, and the Wrist Scale is made from it.
item.desc:frost_fang: Vaka hunt the cold country at night, and the sun does them no harm. This tooth is out of one.
item.desc:bog_pearl: Lees that lay in mud where nothing found it set into this lump. Kaddam swallow it with the mud they lie in.
item.desc:rust_core: Nihirakka are bodied in the harness they ate in Sealed Stores, and this lump of rust comes out of one.
item.desc:spore_sac: Kavak carry raw spore in these sacs. Raw, the sacs eat through iron. So the Guhamāt Smoker is made of Antar.
item.desc:moth_dust: Salaha are bodied in what falls from the great caps. They shed it as this dust. Kites and tonics take it.
item.desc:rift_scale: Vihanga are scaled like this. A Kajjot sometimes carries one, from a dead Vihanga it had been at.
item.desc:shard: Sakal are splintered crystal, and this is a splinter of one. Raw, it cuts and loosens whatever holds it.
item.desc:ash_token: Householders will buy one for a little lees. It charges no pot, and no householder takes it in payment.
item.desc:moon_sliver: A bit of a Chandasāvak's body, lees set hard and pale. The born say the slivers are pieces of the moon.
item.desc:heartroot: Cut from Vanahar, this root still moves. It loosens made things and no ore, the weakest remains of the eight.
item.desc:scorched_core: Maruhar's middle is grit and deep rock. In a ring of Deep Rock over a fire, this piece loosens Jalit and Antar ore.
item.desc:warden_sigil: We cut this pale matter from Kankāl. Framed in Black Glass, it holds an opening to the hollow.
item.desc:queen_spore: Cap and thread of Guhamāt. In a ring of Hollow Rock over a fire, it loosens Tala and Ākās ore.
item.desc:storm_plume: Whatever way it is held, this piece of Jīmūt stands up from the hand. In a frame of Tala bars it opens on the islands.
item.desc:prism_heart: Ratan's body is crystal. In a ring of Island Rock over a fire, this piece loosens Patik ore.
item.desc:eclipse_ember: Kuranga Remains still give the violet light of its kind. In a ring of Black Glass they loosen Gahan ore.
item.desc:cairn_heart: Raw remains of Nihān. Boiled down, they would charge a pot against everything weaker than Nihān.
item.desc:apple: Oaks drop an apple now and then when their leaves are broken, and it is eaten raw.
item.desc:berries: Low wild bushes bear them, most of all in the pine woods. They go into salves, tonics and flower tea.
item.desc:raw_meat: Sheep, grouse and boar give meat, and roasted it feeds a body much longer.
item.desc:cooked_meat: A full meal of roast meat leaves a body mending faster for a while.
item.desc:raw_fish: Caught raw from any open water. It is better roasted.
item.desc:cooked_fish: Fish roasted in a Stone Furnace.
item.desc:stew: Brown and red mushroom boil down together into a plain meal.
item.desc:glow_broth: Glowing mushroom and frond of the hollow take up crystal from the rock. Boiled, they feed and ease the arm a little.
item.desc:skyfruit: On the islands the hour stands, and this fruit neither ripens nor rots. It feeds, and closes wounds a little.
item.desc:salve: Berries and red mushroom are bound on a wound with fibre, and the wound closes. A body takes only so much at once.
item.desc:greater_salve: A salve worked up with spore sac and glowing mushroom closes worse wounds than plain salve.
item.desc:tonic: A little ground crystal in berry juice eases a clenched arm, and the arm answers again.
item.desc:greater_tonic: Salaha dust stirred into a tonic makes it ease more of the arm.
item.desc:ironbark: Bark, brown mushroom and flint steep into a draught. Drunk, it toughens the skin for a few minutes.
item.desc:swiftroot: Yellow flower and berries steeped with fibre quicken the legs for a few minutes.
item.desc:recall_stone: Driven, this lined stone and its Hīrak gem take the bearer to the bed, awake and carrying everything.
item.desc:door: A ward stops no person, so no householder holds a room that has no door. This one is planks on a frame.
item.desc:hollow_gate_kit: Raised wherever its frame will stand, this Black Glass round Kankāl Remains opens on the hollow.
item.desc:rift_gate_kit: Tala bars framed round Jīmūt Remains open on the islands. The frame can stand anywhere on the living ground.
item.desc:verdant_idol: A log with Kinva jelly bound into it with fibre. The born carve it and add a red flower. Vanahar comes up for the jelly.
item.desc:sunken_lure: Gold weights this sandstone round raw meat and Angār dust. It sinks in loose sand, and Maruhar finds it from below.
item.desc:warden_bell: Hīrak is cast into the wall of this iron cup. Set mouth down on a Kankāl Altar, it holds Tama flesh and bone there.
item.desc:spore_censer: Antar holds Kavak sacs on a glowing mushroom, and the sacs smoulder. The smoke carries in the still air of the hollow.
item.desc:storm_kite: Crystal Fiber, grouse feather and a Tala bar, with Salaha dust. On its cord it lifts the dust to where Jīmūt feeds.
item.desc:prism_lens: Glass in a rim of Ākās holds Sakal shards flat on a Ratan Altar. The born say the lens gathers light.
item.desc:eclipse_mask: Patik holds Chandasāvak slivers and Tama flesh. Laid on a Kuranga Altar after dark, it brings Kuranga up.
item.desc:cairn_key: A Hīrak Block bound in Gahan, charged with slivers and shards nobody drives. Nihān comes up through the base for it.
item.desc:strider_boots: Feather lines these close-cut hide boots, and a body walks faster in them.
item.desc:spring_anklet: Gold bent round the ankle holds a pad of Kinva jelly. The pad gives under the foot and springs back.
item.desc:bounding_boots: On the Joining Bench an Anklet is pressed into the heel of Walking Boots.
item.desc:iron_bracer: Iron plates riveted over hide, strapped along the forearm.
item.desc:briar_bracer: Kantak thorn is pressed into the iron of an Arm Guard on the Joining Bench. Whatever strikes it is cut.
item.desc:warriors_band: This band of iron and gold is worn high on the arm, with thorn set into it.
item.desc:marksman_lens: Ground glass in a gold rim, held to the eye when the bow is drawn.
item.desc:reach_gauntlet: Jalit plates the fingers of this hide glove, which runs to the elbow. The hand reaches further in it.
item.desc:tide_fins: Webbed hide is tied over the feet with fibre, with a Lees Lump worked in. A swimmer goes faster in them.
item.desc:sages_ring: A gold ring with crystal on a short line is worn on the driving hand, and it eases the arm.
item.desc:mana_charm: Crystal on an iron mount, worn where the driving arm can use it. The arm takes more before it stops.
item.desc:soul_reliquary: A Locket and a Crystal Charm, pressed into one on the Joining Bench, hang from one chain.
item.desc:heart_locket: Salve is packed into this small hinged case of gold, worn on a chain.
item.desc:duelists_sigil: An Arm Ring and an Eyeglass are worked into one band that sits over the knuckles.
item.desc:lucky_coin: Rubbed smooth, this disc of gold has a Lees Lump set in its face.
item.desc:magnet_shell: Iron is beaten round a lump of rust out of a Nihirakka.
item.desc:binders_whistle: Bone packed with raw Tama flesh. A small feeder forms on the flesh, so one more stays by the hand.
item.desc:delvers_charm: Silahādak scale on gold is worn at the wrist, and rock loosens a little under the pick.
item.desc:shadow_cloak: Crystal Fiber woven with Tama flesh. Its edges are hard to see.
item.desc:cloud_bottle: This glass holds a wad of the pale stuff from under the islands. Let out under the foot, it bears one step in the air.
item.desc:feather_charm: Feather on a gold pin over a pinch of the pale stuff takes the force out of a landing.
item.desc:gale_emblem: The Joining Bench presses a Cloud Bottle and a Feather Charm into one. It gives a step in the air and a soft landing.
item.desc:skyrunner_treads: These boots carry the pale stuff under the heel, for a step in the air and a soft landing.
item.desc:mossheart_sprig: This shoot off Vanahar's body still puts out leaf. Worn against the skin, it mends the body as a salve does.
item.desc:maw_fang: A tooth of Maruhar, the one part of it harder than its plates.
item.desc:wardens_aegis: Kankāl's pale set matter is dense. Whoever carries this plate of it is hard to knock off their feet.
item.desc:mycelial_crown: Small feeders form on this piece of Guhamāt's cap, as they formed round the animal. One more stays by the hand.
item.desc:tempest_feather: Jīmūt is bodied in the pale stuff. It bears weight and has almost none. Whoever wears this piece lands softly.
item.desc:prism_core: No crystal we have cut is denser than this piece of Ratan. A line run to it loses less of what the arm drives.
item.desc:eclipse_shard: Kuranga's tines are lees set hard and pale. This one loosens a little wherever the bearer strikes.
item.desc:sovereign_light: Out of Nihān's body came this piece of cut housing, with its gem still set in it.
item.desc:pot_crystal: One crystal, shaped like the inside of a jar, with fired clay flaking off it. Broken up, it is a great deal of crystal.
block.desc:stone: Bare hands do nothing to it. Any pick, even a wooden one, brings it out as rubble.
block.desc:cobble: A furnace closes rubble back into whole stone.
block.desc:deepstone: Below the common stone lies this darker rock, where Hīrak and Jalit are found. The Maruhar Furnace is ringed with it.
block.desc:bedrock: Every dig ends at this. It is black and cold, and no pick or fire marks it.
block.desc:dirt: Like all ground here, soil stays where it is put, even with nothing under it.
block.desc:grass: Nobody here sows turf. Householders say a sown field brings the woodland feeders up in it at night.
block.desc:sand: Sand runs to glass in a furnace fire.
block.desc:sandstone: Sand that has lain long enough sets again as this. Salt pans are cut into it along the shore.
block.desc:gravel: The deep sea floor is gravel. Flint is picked out of it.
block.desc:clay: Clay is dug from the shallows and fired to brick. Every pot that holds lees is fired clay, because salt eats iron.
block.desc:snow: Snow lies over the cold country and the high peaks, and a shovel takes it.
block.desc:ice: In the cold country the sea is frozen at the top. Ice breaks to nothing.
block.desc:mud: Panka never drains, and this is its ground. Lees that lies in mud sets as it would in rock.
block.desc:snowy_grass: Turf with snow lying on it.
block.desc:scoria: Where the molten rock stands highest, the rock round it is cindery like this.
block.desc:nightglass: Where rock ran and set again deep down, it formed this glass. Gate frames and the Kuranga Furnace are built of it.
block.desc:water: The sea and every channel lie at one height. No feeder comes up in water.
block.desc:lava: Molten rock lies low, near the bottom of every dig. It burns any body that goes in.
block.desc:oak_log: Oak grows in Vana and Yavas. Cut one through at the foot, and the rest of the tree hangs where it stood.
block.desc:oak_leaves: Apples drop now and then from oak leaves.
block.desc:pine_log: Pine grows in the cold country, and the villages of Tusāravan are built of it.
block.desc:pine_planks: Pine splits to planks by hand.
block.desc:pale_log: Birch is the first tree to seed into pasture that nobody grazes. Oak comes up under it later.
block.desc:kapok_log: The tallest trees of the wet wood give this timber. In Kāsa the same tree stands thin, cut for fuel.
block.desc:kapok_leaves: These leaves grow high in the wet wood, over the fern.
block.desc:rose_log: Kusum blossom trees give this timber. Whether the tree came from the islands or grew from this ground is not known.
block.desc:rose_leaves: Leaves and blossom of the Kusum tree.
block.desc:tall_grass: Long grass gives fibre now and then.
block.desc:fern: Fern grows under the trees. Sometimes it gives fibre.
block.desc:flower_red: The born put this red flower on Vanahar's bait. It grows through the green country.
block.desc:flower_yellow: Steeped with berries and fibre, this yellow flower of the grass makes flower tea.
block.desc:flower_blue: This blue flower grows on the islands, and in patches all through the green country.
block.desc:flower_white: The white flower of the islands grows on this ground too, thickest in Kusum.
block.desc:dead_bush: Dry bramble of the sand and the dry grass breaks into sticks.
block.desc:reeds: Reeds grow where grass meets water, and they pull apart into fibre.
block.desc:mushroom_brown: Brown mushroom grows in shade and underground. Stew and Bark Draught are made with it.
block.desc:mushroom_red: Salve and stew both need one of these.
block.desc:cactus: Cactus stands on the sand, and its spines cut a body that brushes it.
block.desc:berry_bush: Picked bare, a berry bush fruits again in time.
block.desc:glowshroom: This mushroom gives light, so nothing comes up near it. It takes up crystal from the rock it grows on.
block.desc:coal_ore: Rock with old timber in it, charred black.
block.desc:iron_ore: Tan flecks in the stone. A stone pick takes it whole, and a wooden one breaks it to nothing.
block.desc:gold_ore: Gold lies deep in the rock, and an ordinary fire melts it out.
block.desc:mana_ore: Lees shut in rock sets hard into a geode of crystal. It gives light, and the rock hides it.
block.desc:lumenite_ore: Hīrak lies low in the living ground, and rarely. The gem comes away from its rock whole.
block.desc:cindrite_ore: This ore lies in the lowest rock but one, beside the molten rock. It is still warm when cut.
block.desc:eclipsium_ore: Violet light shows through the lowest rock there is, which lies against the floor.
block.desc:stone_bricks: Stone cut square at the workbench.
block.desc:mossy_bricks: Fibre worked into the joints of stone bricks turns them green with moss.
block.desc:sandstone_bricks: The old villages of the sand are built of sandstone cut square like this.
block.desc:bricks: Clay fired hard in a furnace.
block.desc:glass: Glass is sand fired clear. Broken, it leaves nothing.
block.desc:wardstone: Whoever cut the old stonework dressed this stone. It has lain dressed so long that it is harder than raw stone.
block.desc:torch: Coal on a stick. Nothing comes up where its light falls.
block.desc:lantern: A lantern is a torch in an iron case, and it gives the same light.
block.desc:workbench: Four planks fitted square, with a true face and a vice. Tools, beds and draughts are made at it.
block.desc:furnace: A ring of rubble round a wood or coal fire melts the soft ores, fires sand and clay, and cooks meat.
block.desc:chest: Ordinary goods in a chest draw nothing. Great remains in it make it a store, and it draws.
block.desc:anvil: Hard metal is shaped on this block of iron, and Hīrak is split on its edge.
block.desc:emberforge: Fire under Maruhar Remains wakes them, and they loosen ore that no fire melts. Deep Rock rings the bed.
block.desc:voidkiln: In a ring of Hollow Rock, Guhamāt Remains loosen ore over a fire. The ore never gets hot.
block.desc:prism_crucible: Island rock rings Ratan Remains over a fire, and Patik ore runs together in the bed.
block.desc:eclipse_forge: Kuranga Remains sit in Black Glass over a fire. They loosen Gahan, the ore that lies against the floor.
block.desc:tinker_bench: Vanahar Remains are held between iron bars over a plank top. Two worked pieces laid against them press into one.
block.desc:runeloom: It holds a stave true while lines are cut along it, and fibre under even tension. Staves and totems are made on it.
block.desc:bedroll: Fibre over boards. After a fall we come out at the bed we last lay on.
block.desc:guest_bed: A householder sits up all night on this hide over boards. In a closed, lit room with a door, one will come.
block.desc:crystal_cyan: Azure crystal stands on cavern floors and hangs from their roofs. Its light stops feeders coming up round it.
block.desc:crystal_violet: Its violet is the light of a Chandasāvak. Lees set in the open grows outward like this.
block.desc:crystal_amber: Amber crystal hangs from cavern roofs. Nobody has matched its colour to any kind of feeder.
block.desc:iron_block: Iron bars packed into a block.
block.desc:gold_block: Beaten into one block, gold bars stay soft.
block.desc:lumenite_block: The Cairn Key is built round a block of Hīrak like this.
block.desc:gloomstone: All the hollow's rock is this. The Guhamāt Furnace is ringed with it.
block.desc:mycel: Fungus turf covers the hollow's rock. Outside the hollow it grows only in deep caverns.
block.desc:gloom_stem: Stem of a great fungus, the only timber in the hollow.
block.desc:gloomcap_teal: This teal cap of a great fungus gives a little light.
block.desc:gloomcap_violet: The violet caps of the great fungi are faintly lit from inside.
block.desc:umbrite_ore: Antar runs through the rock of the hollow at every height.
block.desc:noctrium_ore: Tala lies low in the hollow, down toward the standing water.
block.desc:lumen_frond: This frond of the hollow gives its own light, and nothing comes up where it shines.
block.desc:sporelamp: Lamp fungus hangs from the hollow's roofs and gives a warm light.
block.desc:riftstone: Island ground is this rock under the soil. It rings the Ratan Furnace.
block.desc:skyturf: Island turf, paler and bluer than the grass below.
block.desc:skysoil: Under island turf lies this soil.
block.desc:star_log: Island trees give this timber. Their leaves give light, so nothing comes up under them.
block.desc:star_leaves: Island leaves with a light of their own.
block.desc:aetherium_ore: Ākās is the commonest ore in island rock.
block.desc:prismite_ore: Seams of island metal with crystal grown through them.
block.desc:cloud: The pale stuff hangs in sheets under the islands. It bears weight and does not move.
block.desc:prism_crystal: Sakal feed on this pale crystal of the islands. It is harder than any crystal of the living ground.
block.desc:hollow_frame: Pull any piece of this Black Glass from round the Kankāl Remains, and the opening shuts.
block.desc:rift_frame: Tala round Jīmūt Remains. With one piece taken out, the gate to the islands goes dark.
block.desc:altar1: A great housing on mossy brick, ringed by six living oaks. Vanahar comes up for bait laid on it.
block.desc:altar2: This housing stands on a gilded dais in a bowl of carried sand. Maruhar comes up through the sand.
block.desc:altar3: A housing of dressed stone on a pad of brick. Bait set on it brings Kankāl.
block.desc:altar4: This housing stands in a domed cavern of the hollow, and the smoke of its bait rises to Guhamāt in the roof.
block.desc:altar5: Masts of glassed stone stand round it. A kite goes up from here for Jīmūt, which never lands.
block.desc:altar6: Eight pillars of pale crystal stand round it on a disc of island rock. Ratan comes up to bait laid here.
block.desc:altar7: A housing on a floor of Black Glass and Deep Rock, in the open.
block.desc:altar8: The largest housing of the eight, with lamps all round it. The Cairn Key is laid on top.
block.desc:moss_stone: Moss and root hold the paving round a Vanahar Altar together.
block.desc:bone_block: The pillars round a Kankāl Altar are bone stacked solid.
block.desc:gilded_bricks: Brick faced with gold. Feeders that eat stone get nothing from it.
block.desc:path: Earth packed hard between a village well and its doors.
block.desc:brood_nest: Feeders breed here, on stored lees whose salt failed.
block.desc:crate: Householders who pass through an old house stock its crates.
block.desc:storm_block: What Jīmūt throws loosens stone, and the stone sets again as this glass.
block.desc:salt_crust: Salt dried white on the floor of a shore pan. It breaks to nothing.
block.desc:snow_prints: A run of prints begins in clean snow, with nothing leading to it.
block.desc:ash_glass: Sand runs to glass, black and grey, under a fire that burned kills for a long time. A piece sometimes comes away whole.
block.desc:great_fire: A sand-country place has one fire, on its glassed floor. It burns day and night and harms a body standing in it.
block.desc:charred_planks: A hearth floor burned black. Householders say a march did it. The Deserter says the household did it on leaving.
block.desc:rough_block: It was cut free in a quarry and dressed on its top face only.
block.desc:ward_core: A ward core like those cut at home: black, cold, heavier than stone many times its size. No tool marks it.
block.desc:cairn_base: The base under a Cairn is this dressed stone, and Nihān was bodied in it.
rarity.desc:0: Surface matter and green work: timber, rubble, hide, fibre.
rarity.desc:1: Fire wins this matter from the upper rock: iron, and what is made of it.
rarity.desc:2: Hīrak and Jalit come from the deep rock of the living ground.
rarity.desc:3: Hollow matter is harder than anything of the deep rock.
rarity.desc:4: Island matter, set harder again than the hollow's.
rarity.desc:5: Gahan lay against the floor itself. This grade is Gahan and what is made of it.
rarity.desc:6: Made by the builders of the old stonework and lying made since. Only Nihān has given any.
